bat bones.note: Bat bones: kill a Giant bat outside Keep Le Faye (south-west of Camelot).

black candle.note: Black candle: talk to the Candle Maker in Catherby (twice) until he hands one over.

glarial's pebble.note: Glarial's pebble: ask Golrie in the Tree Gnome Village dungeon (ladder in the maze centre). The key from the off-coloured crate in the east room opens his gate.

saltpetre.note: Saltpetre: dig with a spade at the deposits north-east of the Woodcutting Guild (deposit box in the middle of them).

compost.note: Compost: buy from Vannah's Farming Stall in Hosidius (sells Compost and Compost packs).

buckets of milk.note: Buckets of milk: buy from the Culinaromancer's Chest — climb down the TRAPDOOR here in the castle kitchen (Shortest Path can't draw into the basement; this pin is the trapdoor). The chest also stocks eggs and pots of flour.

bucket of milk.note: Buckets of milk: buy from the Culinaromancer's Chest — climb down the TRAPDOOR here in the castle kitchen (Shortest Path can't draw into the basement; this pin is the trapdoor). The chest also stocks eggs and pots of flour.

fruit blast.note: Fruit blast: a PREMADE fr' blast does NOT work for RFD — mix your own (6 Cooking): buy cocktail shaker, cocktail glass, lemon, orange and pineapple from Funch's Fine Groceries east of Blurberry's Bar (Grand Tree), mix the fruits, add lemon slices. Blurberry gives the ingredients free once: talk, read his cocktail guide, talk again.

teleports.note: Teleport cards: buy from Diango in the Draynor market — they charge the Chronicle (one teleport per card).

teleport cards.note: Teleport cards: buy from Diango in the Draynor market — they charge the Chronicle (one teleport per card).

fishing rod.note: Harry's Fishing Shop, Catherby - stocks fishing rods, lobster pots, harpoons and nets.

candle.note: Candle shop, Catherby - the Candle maker sells plain candles (he also hands over the black candle for Merlin's Crystal).

death runes.note: Death runes: use a grown CAT on a civilian in south-west West Ardougne. 100 runes normally, 200 with the easy Ardougne diary.

sickle mould.note: Dommik's Crafting Store, north-east Al Kharid - Dommik stocks the sickle mould (10gp) and holy mould (5gp), plus ring/necklace/amulet moulds.

pirate's message.note: Pirate's message: in the chest upstairs in the Blue Moon Inn, Varrock.
